summary: Documents a simple experiment of a TCP sender using a four-packet start toward a receiver behind a 9600 bps modem link with only three buffers. The finding was that no significant degradation was seen compared with a smaller start. It is informational.

eli5.summary: What happens if you pour four cups of water into a funnel that holds three? This memo tried it with network packets and found things still worked fine.

questions: what happens when tcp sends four packets into three buffers
does a larger tcp initial window hurt slow links
